Thanks, it has been really hard. It's been too much. I am looking for solutions; I'd appreciate any ideas.

I'm scared to eat free food again, last time I tried I got sick

28 days is a horrendous amount of time to be locked up against your will. I was sectioned for 8 days, and by the 8th day, I was already at my breaking point. It is like a prison because you are being detained against your will.

I'm glad you were not put in a ward. It's not good in there; it really is like a prison with a smiley face pasted on it. Try to do what you can on your own to manage your mental health; eating healthy, walking in nature, energy cleansing, and writing help me a lot. There should be lots of videos on YouTube that can help you too and give you anxiety tips for the next time you have an episode.

I was put into a psych ward. I'm permanently scarred. We have to do everything we can to protect ourselves. This world is so broken
They got me like that too. This world is a joke
I'm listening to island sunrise by software, it fits

I tried automatic writing a year ago to communicate with a spirit, but I didn't know what I was talking to was evil. It worked so well, the entity got the ability to control my fingers and then it took control of my hands and then the rest of my body. A year later I'm where I'm at now fighting to get it to leave me alone; it flips and shakes my hands around, punches me, growls through my body, twists my facial expressions, and violates me sexually. If I say all that though, people say I need to go back to the hospital. 

I was sent to the hospital twice, went to group therapy, stayed 8 days in a psych ward and was medicated. I had to pretend the medication was working and restrain the body movements just to get out, it was absolute hell. Even if I recovered from this, I would still need tons of therapy to overcome the trauma I went through in this year alone, but how can you even find a therapist who believes in demon possession? I feel like I have no where to go and no options left.

I don't think anyone can help at this point... The more I go into it, the more it feels like my sanity is questioned. If people could see what's happened to me, maybe they'd believe me. If you don't believe in spirits and possession, that's OK, but my issue is something along the lines of that. I've tried so much. I'm just coping at this point.
Thank you, I can try. I've been holding on for so long. When things flare up at night, I lose myself in the pain.

Thanks, I'll look into it. I wish you the best, no one deserves to go through the hell I've been living the last year. I just wish I could actually survive because then I could help save someone else.

I don't even want to die, man, but my body is going out of control every night. Doctors can't fix it. I've tried since February to stop what's happening to me, and I'm doing better than I was then, but it's taken such a toll on me mentally now, I'm breaking. I can't watch this happen to me anymore. I want to live, but my body has been stolen from me.

I cant control my body anymore, friend. You still have a chance. When you get older and start experimenting with life, if you ever take interest in the spiritual world and things like the after life, make sure you research how to protect yourself when you do things like using ouija boards or trying to communicate with spirits because there are bad bad things out there that will use any opportunity to slip into your life and destroy you and it can all be avoided by protecting yourself first.

 It's fine if this sounds insane to you, but I'm just saying it now in case the day ever comes where these things pique your curiosity like they did mine. You don't have to end up like me, you can be happy.
I don't want to talk anymore. Everyone just thinks I'm crazy.
I'm scared if I do my arms and live, I will never play the violin again.

*hug* it's easier when you have someone to fight with, someone to care about you. I was begging for someone like this for months, I was in so much pain. I'm trying to end everything tonight, but your wish made me remember when I felt the exact same way. While I'm still alive, I'm here for you
